# Matthew Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old at the beginning of the series; dies at sixty-six.
- **Gender:** Male
- **Status:** Deceased
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island, Canada
- **Role:** Farmer

## Appearance

Matthew is an awkwardly built man with slightly stooped shoulders and dark hair turning gray. He wears a full, dark brown beard that he has kept since he was twenty. He dresses in plain, quiet clothes and usually looks shy and uncomfortable in formal attire.

## Personality

Matthew is painfully shy, particularly in the presence of women and girls, whom he finds intimidating and baffling. Despite his quiet nature, he is deeply kind, gentle, and possessive of a quiet, dry sense of humor. He is an empathetic listener and forms a deep, unconditional bond of affection with Anne from the moment they meet. He often secretly spoils Anne and supports her dreams when Marilla is inclined to be stricter.

## Traits

- Painfully shy
- Gentle and soft-hearted
- Fear of strange women and girls
- Generous and supportive

## Abilities

- Skilled and industrious farmer

## Goals

- To give Anne a happy life and ensure her happiness and success
- To maintain Green Gables alongside Marilla

## History

Matthew Cuthbert lives at Green Gables with his unmarried sister, Marilla. Aging and suffering from a failing heart, Matthew agrees with Marilla to adopt an orphan boy to help with farm work. When Matthew goes to the Bright River station, he finds Anne Shirley instead, whom he immediately grows fond of on the ride home. He gently convinces Marilla to keep Anne, and over the following years, he acts as Anne's sympathetic champion and indulgent father figure. When Anne wants a puffed-sleeve dress for a Christmas concert, Matthew braves his terror of shopwomen to purchase the materials for her. He takes quiet pride in Anne's academic triumphs as she attends Queen's Academy and earns a scholarship to Redmond College. Shortly after Anne completes her studies at Queen's, the Abbey Bank fails, wiping out the Cuthberts' savings; upon reading the news, Matthew suffers a fatal heart attack and dies instantly. His memory continues to deeply inspire and comfort Anne as she goes on to teach and later attend college.

## Background by volume

- Lived his entire life at Green Gables in Avonlea with his sister Marilla
- Never married due to his extreme shyness

## Affiliations

- Cuthbert Family — Head of household / Farmer

- Sibling of — Sister with whom he shares Green Gables
